result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback: it is mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the agreement, capped at 12 months after each individual’s involvement ends, retains the general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and expressly confirms there is no no-hire restriction. The changes are appropriately targeted and preserve the clause’s remaining intent. Drafting is professional, though “performance or receipt of the activities” is slightly awkward and “For purpose” should read “For purposes.”
